description: Computes one or more experimental (sample) variograms from a points or downhole intervals source object and writes them to a new experimental variogram object. A single call can mix omnidirectional, directional (azimuth/dip tolerance cone with optional bandwidth/bandheight) and downhole variograms, each with its own lag definition.

SourceAllOfFilter.description: A composite filter that passes locations satisfying ALL child filters (AND logic).

filters.description: All of these filters must be satisfied (AND logic).

items.description: A filter condition or composite filter combining multiple conditions.

oneOf.description:
A leaf filter condition applied to one attribute of the filtered object.

Exactly one operator field must be provided.

- ``in``: Membership test. Provide string category names for
    ``CategoryAttribute`` objects or integers for integer-coded indices.
- ``not_in``: Exclusion test.
- ``equal``, ``not_equal``: Numeric equality/inequality.
- ``greater_than``, ``greater_than_or_equal_to``, ``less_than``,
    ``less_than_or_equal_to``: Numeric comparisons on numeric attributes.

operator.description: The filter operator. Use 'in' or 'not_in' for category/membership tests (pair with 'values'). Use 'equal', 'not_equal', 'greater_than', 'greater_than_or_equal_to', 'less_than', or 'less_than_or_equal_to' for numeric comparisons (pair with 'threshold').
operator.title: Operator

threshold.description: Numeric threshold for comparison. Required when operator is 'equal', 'not_equal', 'greater_than', 'greater_than_or_equal_to', 'less_than', or 'less_than_or_equal_to'.
threshold.title: Threshold

parameters.description:
Task parameters for the experimental variogram computation.

Sample locations and values are read from a geoscience object (``source``). A single call
computes one or more variograms — any mix of omnidirectional, directional and downhole —
listed in ``directions``, each with its own lag definition. The results are written to a
new experimental variogram geoscience object (``target``).

directions.description: One or more variogram specifications to compute in this call (at most 100). Each entry is an omnidirectional, directional or downhole variogram with its own lag definition, and produces one direction in the output object.

items.description: A single omnidirectional, directional or downhole variogram specification.

oneOf.description: An omnidirectional variogram — all sample pairs binned by separation distance.

lags.description: Lag bin definition. Omit to derive density-based lags automatically from the samples.

ends.description: Upper bounds (exclusive) of each lag bin. Provide with 'starts' for the explicit form.

items.description: A lag bin boundary distance value.
items.title: Lag bound

ends.title: Ends

lag_distance.description: Width of each uniform lag bin. Provide with 'n_lags' for the uniform form.
lag_distance.title: Lag Distance

max_distance.description: Largest separation distance the automatically derived bins may reach. Only valid for the automatic form; omit it to derive the range from the extent of the samples. A common choice is half the extent of the domain being modelled.
max_distance.title: Max Distance

n_lags.description: Number of uniform lag bins. Provide with 'lag_distance' for the uniform form.
n_lags.title: N Lags

starts.description: Lower bounds (inclusive) of each lag bin. Provide with 'ends' for the explicit form.

items.description: A lag bin boundary distance value.
items.title: Lag bound
